items.revision_instructions: Keep slot_id, pain angle, Pattern, Case structural reference, and Persona authority. Use only these three meanings: office-space greenery condition is unstable; ongoing-care capacity is lacking; continuous on-site care is provided. Write natural audience-facing Chinese with low-risk framing. Never use the words 客户痛点, 痛点, 另一个, 已知事实, Persona, 字段, 我们了解到, 客户提到, or any language that explains the internal fact taxonomy. Do not say that either problem causes, explains, relates to, or is solved by another. Add no plant species, yellow leaves, watering, lighting, ventilation, empirical claim, or outcome guarantee.

Keep the product_or_service angle and the three KNOWN facts: office-space greenery rental, on-site/regular care, and enterprise customers. Explain naturally to an external audience that both services are provided. Do not imply that rental inherently, automatically, or contractually includes care. Do not use internal Contract language such as 分开说的两项服务.
